build_coco_caption_dataset: build a COCOCaption dataset class that loads image paths and ground truth captions from an annotation file
review_load_data_list: review the COCOCaption load_data_list method that parses annotations into image_id, img_path, and gt_caption dicts
refactor_coco_caption_backend: refactor the COCOCaption class to use a different file backend for loading remote annotation files
test_load_data_list: test the COCOCaption load_data_list method to verify it correctly extracts image IDs and captions from annotations
summarize_coco_caption_class: summarize the COCOCaption dataset class registered in the mmpretrain DATASETS registry for image captioning tasks
